head: Apple Home doorbell and cameras from LG: prices and order date
dek: The first Apple Home Collection accessories, made by LG, went on order on 13 November: an Indoor Cam for $199.95, a Video Doorbell for $249.95 and an Outdoor Cam for $299.95. They're expected to arrive in mid-December.
details: Apple developed the collection with LG and Schneider; the devices set up in the Home app without a separate app or account. The cameras record 2.5K video with color and infrared night vision; the doorbell adds a second camera that faces down and spots packages. Event video is kept for 10 days through iCloud+ plus on the device, end-to-end encrypted. A floodlight camera ($400), thermostats, sensors and a smart lock are among the roughly 10 accessories planned, with some expected only in early 2027.
where: Orders open since 13 November; delivery expected mid-December
means: If you use Apple's Home app and want a doorbell or camera that works with it from the start, these are the first ones sold under Apple's own collection name.
todo: Check that you pay for iCloud+ if you want the 10 days of saved clips. If you want a lock or thermostat to match, wait: those come later.
